title: Implement replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks
body:
Implement replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks change.
Specifications have already been written. Need to review them and update if necessary. Implement the change after that.

report.question: Five open tasks in replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks/tasks.md cannot be done under the implement-stage constraints, and the 'no open tasks' check cannot pass without breaking them. 6.1 needs a `bench` script in packages/client/package.json (the stage check rejects package.json edits unless tasks.md mentions 'pnpm add' or 'dependenc', and tasks.md is not editable). 6.5/6.6 need .github/workflows/ci.yml and a new benchmark job; 7.1 needs edits to .claude/rules/*, docs/adr/0008-*.md and CLAUDE.md; all of these are forbidden paths. 8.1 depends on those, and 8.3 asks the user to push and confirm on the PR. Bench files, budgets script and tests (6.2-6.4) are already done. How should I proceed?
options: Relax the stage checks/forbidden paths for this change so the implement round may edit package.json, .github, .claude, docs/adr and CLAUDE.md, then resume
Move tasks 6.5, 6.6, 7.1, 8.1 and 8.3 out of the implement stage (e.g. to a follow-up change or human step) and let me only add the bench script in package.json
